versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the tw-phone-accessories-market skill.
- Enables detailed research and comparison of Taiwan and Taobao phone accessory markets, focusing on accessories only (excluding devices).
- Supports workflows for sourcing, price tracking, materials/spec research (MagSafe/Qi2/ultra-thin cases), supplier selection, inventory planning, pricing, B2B/group buy offers, and launch marketing content.
- Outlines a standardized data collection process, strict evidence-based validation, and best practices for market analysis and reporting.
- Provides structured output fields and reporting format for consistent, actionable insights.
